segments.name: Search AI
segments.description: Sells search-powered software and cloud services that help organizations search, observe and secure their data across self-managed and cloud deployments.
segments.evidence: The Company operates in one operating segment and, therefore, one reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay subscription fees for cloud-hosted or self-managed software, and also pay for consulting and training services.
revenueModel.evidence: Our paid offerings for our platform are sold via subscription through resource-based pricing, and all customers and users have access to varying levels of features across all solutions.
